1) Heard the learned Counsel for the applicant and the learned APP for the State.

No. 382 of 2023, registered with Varje Police Station, Pune, for the offences punishable under Section 406, 409, 419 and 420 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("the Penal Milind Madhukar Joshi vs The State Of Maharashtra on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21627833/

sentences.text: The applicant had allegedly induced the son in law of the first informant to part with a sum of Rs.1,90,000/- by making arrangements for a Visa and stay in Denmark.
The applicant neither provided the services nor returned the amount.

Hence,
the report.
4) The learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that Visa could not be secured on account of the delay on the part of the first informant.
Only a sum of Rs.4,62,600/- has been credited to the account of the applicant.
The sum of Rs.1,90,000/-, which the son-in-law of the first informant had paid, has already been returned to him.

The learned Counsel submits that the applicant is willing to deposit the amount of Rs.4,62,600/-
within a reasonable period.
5) The learned APP resisted the application for pre-arrest bail.
It was submitted that the allegations in the FIR indicate that there might be other victims.
The learned APP seeks time to take instructions as the Investigating Officer is not present.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6 ) Having regard to the nature of the accusation and the submission that the sum of Rs.1,90,000/- has already been repaid to the son-in-law of the first informant and the applicant has shown willingness to deposit the amount of Rs.4,62,600/-,
which was paid through the banking channels, it may be expedient to grant interim protection while directing the applicant to join in the investigation.

7) Hence, the following order:-
 ORDER I) As undertaken, the applicant shall deposit the amount of Rs.4,62,600/- within a period of one month from today.
II) Subject to the aforesaid deposit, in the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with C.R.
No. 382 of 2023, registered with Varje Police Station, Pune, for the offences punishable under Section 406, 409, 419 and 420 of Indian Penal Code, 1860, the applicant be released on bail on executing a PR Bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.

16-ABA-3540-23.DOC III) The applicant shall co-operate with the investigation and attend Varje Police Station, Pune on 27 th and 28th December, 2023 and 3rd and 4th January, 2024 in between 10.00 am to 1.00 pm and, thereafter, as and when directed by the Investigating Officer.
IV) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and/or give threat or inducement to the first informant and any of the persons acquainted with the facts of the case.
V) Stand over to 5th February, 2024.
[N. J. JAMADAR, J.]
